biotools.summary: PhysiCell Studio is a graphical tool designed to simplify the creation and modification of multicellular models using the PhysiCell framework. It provides a GUI for editing XML model definitions, facilitating the creation, deletion, and simulation of cell types and substrates, and allowing users to view results interactively.
